verdict.rationale: Isaac connects to ROS 2 through a ROS bridge and Isaac ROS packages, which implies standard ROS message types. It also offers simulated RTX and physics-based sensors, stereo camera capture, and hardware-in-the-loop testing. However, the evidence never mentions ready-made drivers for physical cameras, lidars, IMUs, or GPS, and most of the sensor material describes simulated sensors rather than hardware bring-up. Missing for 10: documented hardware drivers for cameras, lidars, IMUs and GPS; an explicit list of supported sensor message types; and hands-on or independent corroboration of real-sensor integration.
